title: contracts
responsibility: Defines the compile-time query records, options, matched fields and relationship results; it exports no runtime values.

outputs.name: ContractEntry
outputs.type: { id: string; kind: string; title: string; path: string; contractPath: string; responsibility: string; manifest: ComponentManifest; states: Array<ScenarioManifest["states"][number] & { scenario: string }> }
outputs.description: Exported compile-time record shape, not a runtime return value. Contains the validated manifest, its current file and owned source paths, summary metadata and attached scenario states.

outputs.name: ContractSummary
outputs.description: Exported type alias retaining only id, kind, title, path, contractPath and responsibility; it declares no runtime value.

outputs.name: ContractOptions
outputs.type: { root?: string; kind?: string; area?: string; folder?: string; includeRetired?: boolean; limit?: number; json?: boolean; regex?: boolean; ignoreCase?: boolean; depth?: number }
outputs.description: Exported optional query settings. CLI parsing validates limit and depth; dispatch applies current-directory root, twenty search matches and one relationship hop when omitted.

outputs.name: ContractMatch
outputs.type: ContractSummary & { field: string; snippet: string; score: number }
outputs.description: Exported search-result type extending summary metadata with the best matched field, bounded text context and ranking score; no runtime value is exported.

outputs.name: ContractMap
outputs.type: { query: string; matches: ContractSummary[]; dependencies: ContractSummary[]; dependents: ContractSummary[]; unresolved: string[] }
outputs.description: Exported relationship-result shape with original query, owning contracts, separate edge directions and unresolved contract ids; no runtime value is exported.

outputs.name: ContractField
outputs.type: { field: string; text: string; weight: number }
outputs.description: Exported internal search-projection type: a field label, its stored text value and relative ranking weight; no runtime value is exported.
